pricing: Custom quote-based pricing (per-user licensing + platform fee). No public pricing tiers. No explicit free plan mentioned.

name: Gemini Code Assist
pricing: Standard: $22.80/user/month (monthly) or $19/user/month (annual). Enterprise: $54/user/month (monthly) or $45/user/month (annual). 30-day free trial available for up to 50 users. CLI is free with 60 req/min and 1000 req/day.
install_method: IDE extensions via marketplace (VS Code, JetBrains) or CLI via npx/npm/homebrew
what_makes_it_special: 1M token context window, enterprise security and IP indemnification, code customization using private codebases, deep integration with Google Cloud services (Firebase, BigQuery, Apigee, Application Integration). name: JetBrains AI
model_providers: JetBrains (Mellum), OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, AWS (Bedrock)
pricing: AI Free: $0. AI Pro: $100/user/year. AI Ultimate: $300/user/year. AI Enterprise: $720/user/year. Also available as part of All Products Pack ($239/year second year, $179/year third year onwards).
install_method: Built into JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, RubyMine, RustRover, CLion, DataGrip). AI Assistant included with JetBrains AI licenses. Junie installed automatically as part of AI Assistant in select IDEs.
what_makes_it_special: Deep integration of AI features with code understanding and core IDE workflows. Ecosystem includes AI Assistant (assistive), Junie (autonomous coding agent), and Grazie (writing companion). Supports bring-your-own-key (BYOK) for OpenAI and Anthropic, local models via Ollama/LM Studio, on-premises LLMs via Hugging Face. Agent Client Protocol (ACP) enables third-party agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot). Enterprise-ready with on-premises, cloud, and hybrid deployment options.
notes: MCP support not explicitly confirmed; JetBrains uses its own Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for agent integration. Junie is the autonomous coding agent component. Mellum is JetBrains' proprietary code completion model.

name: Softgen
model_providers: Anthropic (Claude 4.5), OpenAI (GPT-5.4), Google (Gemini 3.1 Pro), Kimi, Qwen (12+ models total)
pricing: Starts at $25/mo, free trial credits included (no card required)

AI asks clarifying questions and creates a development plan before building. One-click integrations for Google Analytics, GTM, PostHog, Hotjar, Clarity, Mixpanel, Meta Pixel, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Intercom, and Zendesk.

name: Databutton
pricing: Starter: $20/mo (75 credits). Launch: $50/mo (200 credits). Scale: $200/mo (1,000 credits). Unlimited: $500/mo (unlimited credits). App Launch Program: from $5,000 (4 weeks, expert-built first version).
what_makes_it_special: Highly non-developer-friendly AI app builder - users describe their app in natural language and collaborate with an AI agent to iterate. 1-click deploy to *.databutton.app or custom domains. Expert human assistance available. Users retain full ownership of their code and IP. 1 credit = 1 AI code generation.
notes: As of 2026, databutton.com redirects to riff.ai (a different product - AI agents for manufacturing/operations by Cognite). The original Databutton AI app builder appears to be discontinued/rebranded. Pricing and features above are from the 2024 archived version.

name: Marblism
pricing: Yearly: $24/mo. Quarterly: $33/mo. Monthly: $44/mo. All plans include access to all AI employees, 50h work/mo, unlimited chat/businesses/team members, 100+ languages, 24/7 support.
what_makes_it_special: AI employee platform with 6 pre-built AI workers: Eva (Executive Assistant), Sonny (Social Media Manager), Stan (Lead Generation), Walter (Website Builder), Penny (SEO Expert), Rachel (Receptionist), Linda (Legal Assistant). AI-to-AI collaboration between employees. 700M+ lead database. 40K+ businesses. 7-day money-back guarantee.
notes: Product has pivoted from its original description as an AI full-stack app generator/SaaS builder. The current product is an AI employee platform for business automation, not a coding agent.

Plan mode for structured planning before generation. MCP connectors for external tools. Backend support via Supabase. Publish as live website with dedicated URL. Make kits package design systems into reusable AI context. Copy as design layers converts Make previews into editable Figma Design layers.
